facts: R/S labels describe the chiral 1-phenylethyl substituents used in synthesis, not a supplied backbone assignment.
The fused dimer and monomer have different stoichiometries and connections. Differences in their total electronic energies are not optical transition energies or a balanced association energy.

Experimental optical observations and ancillary chromatography/NMR conditions are provided in solution_observations.json. No measured conformer free energies or calibrated molecular spectral tolerance is supplied.
measurement_definitions: Absorption and circular dichroism are distinct observables. State the sign, units, normalization and broadening convention of every simulated or experimental quantity used.

The absorption dissymmetry factor is g_abs=2(A_L-A_R)/(A_L+A_R), using matched wavelength and concentration conventions; a near-zero denominator cannot support a robust large dissymmetry claim. It is distinct from a device photocurrent dissymmetry factor.

Population weighting requires a physically justified relation to the prepared sample and measurement conditions. Chromatographic peak areas or NMR ratios under other conditions are not automatically Boltzmann weights for the optical experiment.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
